actions.label: Post out-of-scope release-notification reply

comment.body: Thanks for the detailed feedback. Based on the discussion here, this is not tracking a PowerToys 0.101 app regression: the notifications are generated by GitHub when this repository publishes releases that are marked as pre-release, and GitHub currently does not provide a stable-release-only watch option. PowerToys preview releases are being used intentionally for canary-style community validation, so there is no app-side fix to design from this issue. If maintainers want to keep tracking the release-channel policy separately, this should be treated as product/release-process feedback rather than a 0.101 bug.
